name: Arashi
source:
Though it may seem like an exaggeration, Arashi is apparently the most popular guy at Michi's school. He excels in many different areas: physical appearance, academics, sports and he even has an overly kind personality. The perfect prince charming whom Michi had a once-in-a-lifetime chance of dating, but eventually broke her heart for reasons beyond her.

With all these positive qualities and traits comes drawbacks. He tends to be naive and oblivious to his surroundings and has difficulty saying what's on his mind.
